personality_one_liner: A map-first Material Design 3 interface using tonal surfaces, expressive emergency actions, and accessible step-by-step reporting.

spacing.rule: Generous safe-area padding for map overlays. Ensure tap targets for emergency actions are massive. Floating elements must have safe clearance from screen edges.

do's: Use glassmorphism for floating UI elements over the map (top status bar, bottom tab bar) to maximize map visibility
Use glass for the bottom sheet drag handle area
dont's: Do not use glass for the primary SOS button; it must be solid brandPrimary for absolute contrast
Do not use glass on critical text reading areas

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Minimalist login screen focusing on Google Sign-In for quick access.
screens.layout: Centered layout. Large App Logo. Primary action 'Sign in with Google' using the Google logo.

screens.name: FamilyCircle
screens.purpose: Private group where users add family members via an invite code and monitor each other's live location over GPS and the Bluetooth mesh network.

states.empty: Illustration prompting the user to create or join a circle.

screens.layout: Full-screen scrollable sheet. Header with back button and title. Each circle card shows its name, owner-only invite code, member list with live location (GPS or mesh source), distance, and recency, plus remove/leave actions. A create form (optional name) and a join form (invite code) sit at the bottom. Family member positions also appear as green (GPS) or blue (mesh) markers on the MapHome.

screens.name: MapHome
screens.purpose: The primary dashboard. Full-screen map showing incident markers, network status, and immediate access to SOS.

states.empty: Map with no markers, indicating safe zone.
states.error: Mapbox error state with 'Retry Connection' overlay.

screens.layout: Absolute full-screen map. Top safe area contains a floating glass header showing Network Status (Online vs Bluetooth Mesh). Bottom safe area has a floating tab bar. Above the tab bar sits a giant, solid red, circular SOS button (center) and a 'Report' FAB (right). Custom map markers use high-contrast icons for Fire, Flood, Crash, Quake.

screens.name: IncidentReportSheet
screens.purpose: Quickly report a disaster to nearby users. Opens as a bottom sheet.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet (min 50% height). Uses a Bento-box grid of 4 large square buttons (Kebakaran, Banjir, Gempa, Tabrakan). After selection, a full-width sticky CTA at the bottom confirms location and sends the report.

screens.name: SOSCountdown
screens.purpose: Full-screen high-stress modal that counts down before broadcasting an SOS. Allows cancellation.
screens.layout: Full-bleed Red (brandPrimary) background. Giant numeric typography for countdown (5..4..3..2..1) in the center. A large 'Batalkan / Cancel' button at the bottom third.

screens.name: MeshChatList
screens.purpose: List of nearby devices or ongoing emergency broadcast chats via Bluetooth.

states.empty: Illustration of searching for nearby peers.

screens.layout: Standard iOS list view. A pinned status chip at the top indicates 'X Peers Nearby'. List items show connection strength.

screens.name: MeshChatRoom
screens.purpose: Offline chat interface. Must clearly show message delivery status.
screens.layout: Standard chat interface inside KeyboardAvoidingView. Message bubbles include explicit metadata (Queued, Relayed, Delivered) to reflect mesh reality. Pinned header shows active peers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the iOS-Native Clean layout principles: map is the hero, UI chrome is floating and minimal.
Implement the map as a full-screen absolute layer. Ensure all top headers and bottom tabs respect Safe Area and float above the map using glassmorphism (`expo-glass-effect` or `expo-blur`).
The SOS button must be prominent (circular, massive) and sit above the bottom tabs. Use `hitSlop` to increase its touch target.
Build the Incident Report feature inside a `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` configured for at least 50% height. Do not navigate away from the map to report an incident.
In the offline Mesh Chat room, it is critical to display the transport status of each message (Queued, Relayed, Delivered) as offline mesh networks are not instantaneous.
For the SOS Countdown, implement a full-screen modal overlay with a 5-second countdown. Integrate haptic feedback (`haptics.sos_countdown_tick`) on every second change.
The app must support Indonesian (ID) and English (EN). Ensure UI elements and buttons (like 'Batalkan / Cancel') have enough width to accommodate text expansion.
Ensure every interactive element has a `testID` attribute.
Always apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 0: expo-image, Layer 1: linear-gradient, Layer 2: text) when overlaying text on image backgrounds like the Auth screen.
